workflow.name: Run an Apify actor
workflow.description: Runs any Apify actor (scrapers for Google Maps, Instagram, TikTok, websites…) with your APIFY_API_KEY and saves the results as JSON in Artifacts.

nodes.label: Run actor
nodes.command:
import json, os, sys, urllib.parse, urllib.request

# Runs an Apify actor and waits for its dataset. Key: Hive › Keys › APIFY_API_KEY.
token = os.environ.get("APIFY_API_KEY")
if not token:
    sys.exit("APIFY_API_KEY is not set: add it in Hive › Keys")
actor = os.environ["HIVE_INPUT_ACTOR"].strip().replace("/", "~")
run_input = json.loads(os.environ.get("HIVE_INPUT_INPUT") or "{}")

url = f"https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/{urllib.parse.quote(actor, safe='~')}/run-sync-get-dataset-items?format=json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(run_input).encode(), method="POST",
                             headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r:
    items = json.load(r)

out = os.path.join(os.environ["ARTIFACTS_DIR"], "items.json")
with open(out, "w") as f:
    json.dump(items, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"{len(items)} items from {actor} -> {out}")
